trajectory.thought: The leader is a seeded baseline (median of full pool) and the verdict is 'indistinguishable' — the runner-up is not statistically better. The diagnosis confirms the series is close to noise with unstable rankings and high error correlation, making a robust median the natural choice. More turns are unlikely to turn noise into a real gain.

action_args.justification: The series has strong trend and seasonality but a near-white-noise spectrum (spectral entropy 0.89), unstable model rankings (Kendall tau -0.014), and highly correlated errors (mean corr 0.913, only 1 independent model). In this regime, a robust median over the full pool avoids overfitting to any single window's ranking and is insensitive to the few outlying models. The leader's margin over the runner-up is not statistically distinguishable, confirming that no alternative combination provides a real gain.
